details.name: GPT Image 1 (high)
details.note:
Generated using the OpenAI Images API with `model_id: "gpt-image-1"` and `quality: "high"`.

  Prompts were pre-pended with "Create the following as a square image:" for Text to Image, and "Edit the following to create a square image:" for Image Editing.


  We found without pre-pending these instructions, images would not be produced natively as squares.

details.name: Ideogram 4.0 Fast (Quality)
details.note: Generated with fal.ai's optimized version of the Ideogram 4.0 open weights model. fal's Fast variant is an FP4-quantized checkpoint trained with quantization-aware distillation, with classifier-free guidance distilled into a single branch for faster inference. Run with fal's QUALITY rendering speed setting.

details.name: FLUX.2 [dev] Turbo
details.note: FLUX.2 [dev] Turbo is a distilled LoRA adapter for Black Forest Lab's FLUX.2 [dev] that generates images in 8 inference steps

details.name: Ideogram 4.0 Instant
details.note: Generated with fal.ai's optimized version of the Ideogram 4.0 open weights model. fal's Instant variant is an FP4-quantized checkpoint trained with quantization-aware distillation, with classifier-free guidance distilled into a single branch and additional timestep distillation to reduce denoising steps.

details.name: Ideogram 4.0 Fast
details.note: Generated with fal.ai's optimized version of the Ideogram 4.0 open weights model. fal's Fast variant is an FP4-quantized checkpoint trained with quantization-aware distillation, with classifier-free guidance distilled into a single branch for faster inference. Run with fal's BALANCED rendering speed setting.

details.name: FLUX.2 [dev] Flash
details.note: FLUX.2 [dev] Flash is the same weights as FLUX.2 [dev] Turbo (a distilled LoRA adapter for Black Forest Lab's FLUX.2 [dev]) that generates images in 5 inference steps

details.name: HiDream-O1-Image
details.note: HiDream-O1-Image is the original HiDream O1 model. HiDream has since introduced HiDream-O1-Image-Dev-2604, a fine-tuned version built specifically for Text to Image, as well as HiDream-O1-Image-1.5, which have been benchmarked and listed separately.

details.name: HunyuanImage 3.0 (Fal)
details.note: HunyuanImage 3.0 is an open weights model. Generated using Fal with settings per Tencent's GitHub.

details.name: HiDream-O1-Image-Dev
details.note: HiDream-O1-Image-Dev is the faster, distilled version of HiDream O1. HiDream has since introduced HiDream-O1-Image-Dev-2604, a fine-tuned version built specifically for Text to Image, as well as HiDream-O1-Image-1.5, which have been benchmarked and listed separately.

details.name: Gemini Omni Flash
details.note: **A note on coverage:** Gemini Omni Flash declined to generate some of our Video Editing prompts due to content blocks, most commonly on prompts involving people. Its results on our Video Editing Leaderboard reflect the prompts it successfully generated.
